title: Mathura College Explorer
scope: This discovery set combines the Mathura district administration's public college directory with Mathura institutions named in the supplied UPTAC preference-order PDF. It is not a census of every school, college, university, or training centre in the district. Confirm current courses, faculty appointments, approvals, fees, and admissions with each institution.
